content.text:
Confirmed: Discussion [#13099](https://github.com/jdx/mise/discussions/13099) is a valid bug in mise 2026.9.5.

I reproduced it with the supplied configuration and official 2026.9.5 binary. `pitchfork@2.24.2` installed successfully on macOS ARM64, then lock generation failed on `linux-arm64-musl` and preserved the previous lockfile.

Root cause:

- Packslip returns private `NoHostArtifact` when a release lacks a matching artifact ([code](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/8527fa458e1b3951780265a0893c98872b2e1fbc/src/backend/packslip.rs#L337-L373)).
- `resolve_lock_info` wraps and propagates that ordinary error ([code](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/8527fa458e1b3951780265a0893c98872b2e1fbc/src/backend/packslip.rs#L1648-L1695)).
- The shared resolver only classifies `Error::UnsupportedTarget` specially ([code](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/8527fa458e1b3951780265a0893c98872b2e1fbc/src/lockfile.rs#L3147-L3159)).
- Generate mode skips only that classification; every other error aborts generation ([code](https://github.com/jdx/mise/blob/8527fa458e1b3951780265a0893c98872b2e1fbc/src/lockfile/generate.rs#L400-L405)).

The proposed fix is correctly scoped: translate only `NoHostArtifact` to `Error::UnsupportedTarget` inside Packslip lock resolution. Ambiguous artifact selection, verification failures, malformed manifests, missing URLs, and requirement errors should remain fatal.

Recommended regression coverage:

- A Packslip no-match becomes `UnsupportedTarget`.
- Generate mode omits that platform without creating an empty entry.
- Ambiguous artifact selection remains a hard failure.

This was exposed by the complete generator added in [PR #13031](https://github.com/jdx/mise/pull/13031); it is separate from the Erlang churn fixed by that generator. I made no repository or GitHub changes.
make a pr, post a reply

I’ll implement the narrow Packslip error conversion on a clean branch from current `origin/main`, add focused regression coverage, run the relevant tests and lint, then open a ready-for-review PR and reply to the discussion with the verified diagnosis and PR link. I’ll re-check the discussion immediately before posting in case new comments change the context.
